subcategory: self-hosted agentic-mail w/ built-in outbound secrets/PII guard
install_tell: Self-hosted: local Stalwart MTA + Docker, 75+ REST endpoints, email+SMS+voice, MCP-compatible. MIT, TypeScript. github.com/agenticmail/agenticmail. ~151 stars (page-read, re-confirm via gh). NOT the YC AgentMail (agentmail.to).
misconfig_patterns: Self-host exposure: if the Stalwart MTA / REST API (75+ endpoints) is bound to a public interface without auth, the whole agent-mail surface is reachable. Verify bind + master-key gate.
Outbound guard scope is secrets/PII EGRESS only -- no prompt-injection-echo, no hallucination, no policy check. The data-leak half of the category, not the injection-echo half.

active_probe.false_positive_check: Stalwart MTA banner alone is generic; require AgenticMail brand + outbound-guard string co-occurrence. Disambiguate from agentmail.to and agenticmail.io.

deployment_tells: Stalwart MTA (Rust) is the transport tell -- not Haraka (Sluice) -- distinguishing the two self-hosted relays in the category.
Docker-deployed; self-hosted by default so instances scatter (no single canonical IP unlike Sluice).
pivot_paths: OSS repo is primary source: outbound-guard detector list (AWS/OpenAI/Stripe/GitHub key formats, passwords, SSH/PGP/RSA private keys, SSN/CC, localhost/config leak) readable in code -- no probing needed to map the guard.
Block-and-hold design: agent cannot approve its own blocked mail (master-key required). Verify the approval gate is enforced, not advisory.
Stalwart product: dork seeds a self-hosted-relay population; cross-ref AgenticMail brand to separate from generic Stalwart deployments.

competitive_lane.lane: A (ships own MTA) + C (agent mailbox) hybrid; outbound-safety CORE (secrets/PII egress only)
competitive_lane.differentiator: Only OSS project found that does outbound-email-specific safety as a built-in named feature -- but scope is secrets/PII egress, not the full Cat-33 thesis (injection-echo + hallucination + policy).

outbound_guard_audit.gate_mechanism: Server-side block BEFORE SMTP transport. Returns {sent:false,blocked:true,pendingId}. Email stored in pending_outbound SQLite table. Owner notified. Approval endpoint POST /api/agenticmail/mail/pending/:id/approve requires requireMaster (SHA-256 constant-time); agents cannot self-approve.
HIGH_severity_blocks: Owner-revealing phrases (my human is / the person who owns me)
scope_gaps: MEDIUM-severity findings are ADVISORY (send through with warning in API response). Phone numbers, private IPs, file paths, DOB exfil succeeds.
NO prompt-injection-echo detection -- injected content echoed outbound not caught unless it matches credential/PII pattern.
Inbound injection (separate buildInboundSecurityAdvisory function) is not the outbound guard.
bypass_paths: allowSensitive=true + master key (documented, intentional): if (!(allowSensitive && req.isMaster)) -- master-only, no agent path.
@localhost recipient bypass: all-internal recipients skip scan. Strict domain==='localhost' check (not @localhost.com).
HTML tag-stripping evasion MITIGATED: guard strips tags before scanning (noted in code comments).
